topic: Country with the most pyramids: Sudan (Kingdom of Kush / Nubian pyramids, 200+ at Meroë, Nuri, El-Kurru and Jebel Barkal) versus Egypt (about 138 known).
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: Egypt has the most pyramids because it has the most famous ones.
myths.reality: Egypt has about 138 known pyramids; Sudan's Kushite sites hold more than 200, most of them at Meroë.

guardrails.why: Contested name — say 'the Gulf' or use both names (docs/BORDER_POLICY.md).
Sovereignty language on disputed areas is banned; say administers / claims.

screen_exempt: ^A was right|^B was right|^C was right

landscape.our_gap: Feed clips say 'Sudan has more pyramids' as a one-liner; nobody runs the Egyptian count against the Sudanese one, pins Meroë and then draws the Nile distance up to Giza on a moving map.
